dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Strongly concave trailing edge exhibiting a parabolic curvature from the apex to the posterior base insertion.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a medium-radius arc, classified as obtuse.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 55 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge baseline.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.7:1 ratio of horizontal base chord to vertical height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple small, light-colored circular spots on the lateral surface of the dorsal fin and minor structural irregularities along the lower trailing edge margin.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent horizontal linear pale scar on the dorsal ridge leading to the anterior insertion of the fin.
